title: Checkout quote API schema
text: POST /checkout/quote requires code:string and subtotal:integer minor units. Local-only now:date-time injects clock. Responses: 200 {total:integer}; 422 {error:PROMO_EXPIRED}; 404 {error:UNKNOWN_CODE}. Promo rate 20 percent. Equality is accepted.

title: Inventory reservation contention / api_specs
text: POST /reservations {sku,quantity} plus Idempotency-Key. 201 {reservationId}; 409 {error:OUT_OF_STOCK}. GET /stock/{sku} returns {available:integer}. No external payments occur during reservation.

title: Tenant cache isolation / api_specs
text: GET /profile requires bearer JWT with tenantId and sub. 200 {tenantId,userId,displayName,roles}. 401 for missing tenant. Tenant is derived from verified token, never query parameters.
